authority_basis.summary: Record the derived-flatness result for the rank-one Gram special fiber.

operations.title: The rank-one Gram special fiber has no higher base-change Tor
operations.body: The two-normal double-cover ring is monic in W and free with basis (1,W) over Q[s,t,x1,x2,x3]. Its derived specialization at s=t=0 is ordinary specialization Q[x1,x2,x3,W]/(W²), with no higher Tor and one intrinsic square-zero Cartier layer.

operations.title: Rank-one Gram derived-fiber flatness certificate
operations.body: The checker records the canonical free rank-two module presentation, zero higher base-change Tor, and the two Cartier grades of the doubled special fiber.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the generic rank-one Gram corner
operations.body: Entry 1177: retaining W makes the two-normal family ring monic and free over Q[s,t,x], so specialization to s=t=0 has no higher Tor. The special fiber is Q[x,W]/(W²), with only the intrinsic two-grade Cartier layer. Combined with Entry 1176's trivial commuting inertia, the generic rank-one Gram corner closes under existing carrier/coefficient machinery. I propose returning to a source-defined marked-relative operation rather than pursuing the radial rank-zero origin.
